known_reset_affinity.description: Both transports marked a known idle reset as unknown work, blocking an unrelated conversation.
known_reset_affinity.correction: Keep the current epoch metadata during reset; mark provenance unresolved only when acquiring a new packet.

late_post_callback.description: Multiroom invoked post-processing after a command ignored cancellation and returned following source revocation; single input already guarded this boundary.
late_post_callback.correction: Require live dispatch sources before callback entry and again after it returns, before processing or forwarding its result.

intermittent_argument_retention.description: An existing rejected auxiliary input remained reachable after observing its error. Fixed native outcomes avoided error tracebacks but executor tuples could still retain direct raw arguments after native return.

deterministic_transport_retention.description: Retain the worker transport argument tuple deliberately after its normal return. Both callback failure and revoked-input cases kept the raw ndarray before the box fix.
deterministic_transport_retention.correction: Transport only a mutable input box. Native completion empties its callback/argument fields before future publication. A controller clears a box only if no worker admitted it; cancellation cannot mutate another running invocation.

superseded_full_suite.description: The suite passed its then-collected cases, but later post-callback and transport-retention checks contradicted candidate completeness. This is not the final validation. Rerun the complete suite only after both fixes.

remaining_scope: PRODUCERS journal remains unconnected.
